visual_review.method: All 25 final pages rendered by pdftoppm at 95 dpi and visually inspected individually in five batches. All displayed equations, tables, theorem text, references and page transitions are legible with no clipping, overlap or missing glyphs.
visual_review.build: Final two pdflatex passes after four long-display line-break corrections; no overfull boxes or undefined references.

scope: Finite algebraic and synthetic Jacobi checks complement the complete written analytic proofs; no hypothetical zeta zeros were numerically tested.
